//: Render-critical IoC keys — the minimum set that must register before
the first hive frame can paint: Pixi host, settings, hex math, layout
solver, the cell renderer, and the background. The module BUILD stamps
this list into manifest.json (renderCriticalKeys); the shell's
ScriptPreloader reads it from the cached install manifest and gates
find() on it — the shim itself carries no module names.
Keep this list small: every entry blocks first paint. If a drone
belongs here, it is because the visible grid genuinely cannot render
without it. Tile-action / overlay / network / history drones do NOT
belong here. The _ShowCellDrone entry is the dev-shell hot-reload
